pages.text: Magnesium is made by combining water and quicklime in a vat. It is used in a couple recipes itself. But it's main purpose is to combine it with impure titanium to Make Titanium.
pages.title: Magnesium and Titanium

pages.text: Magnesium is required to make Titanium which is used in some of the more advanced recipes. To obtain Magnesium you need to mix quicklime(molten limestone) with water. This will create a random dust, which you should melt in a crucible furnace. (Not all the water is used).
pages.title: Magnesium

pages.text: This will most likely give you Molten Magnesium but if you have mods that add cobalt or nickel, you may get these instead.
Titanium is made by combining Magnesium and Rutile, you must combine them in a vat. 1 Magnesium and 1 Rutile will give you 1 Titanium.
pages.title: Titanium

pages.text: $(l)Fluid:$() 1 ingot Molten Magnesium$(br)$(l)Fluid:$() 1 ingot Molten Rutile$(br)$(l)Output Fluid:$() 1 ingot Molten Titanium$(br)$(l)Time:$() 1s
pages.title: Making Titanium
